source_name: mBank S.A. – Relacje inwestorskie / wyniki finansowe Grupy mBanku (parent filings for the Slovak branch)
why_relevant: mBank operates in Slovakia only as a pobočka zahraničnej banky with no local investor-relations disclosure, so the Warsaw parent's raporty roczne are the only place its Slovak operating model, platform and any technology partners are described. Requires Polish-language search, an extra language beyond the run's sk/en.

source_name: Tatra banka – Tlačové správy (press releases blog)
why_relevant: Tatra banka is Slovakia's self-declared innovation leader and routinely names its technology partners in launch releases (e.g. the TABI kids app release credits GoodRequest and ISW for technical development, and Made by Vaculik/Sorry We Can for concept). This is often the only public trace of a private vendor contract and it dates the go-live.

source_name: Tatra banka – Innovation hub (Innovations / FinTech Scout)
why_relevant: Standing page describing the bank's innovation programme, including the Global FinTech Scout Program run with RBI Group – a pointer to which fintech vendors the RBI group (and therefore Tatra banka) is scouting and piloting.

source_name: Slovenská sporiteľňa – Aktuality (news / press)
why_relevant: Largest Slovak retail bank (Erste group). Its news feed carries ATM-fleet modernisation, George digital-banking releases, branch changes and outage notices – directly on-cell for ATM fleet renewal, wallet and mobile-app go-lives.

source_name: VÚB banka – Tlačové centrum
why_relevant: No.2 bank (Intesa Sanpaolo group). Official press centre with press releases, analytical reports and media assets; announces product/digital launches and partner names. English mirror exists.

source_name: ČSOB Slovensko – Tlačové správy (Pre médiá)
why_relevant: KBC-group bank; its media section publishes group news including M&A (the 365.bank acquisition), digital-channel launches and partner announcements. Strategically important now that the group is consolidating two Slovak banks – implies platform-migration vendor work.

source_name: Poštová banka / 365.bank – Tlačové správy
why_relevant: Poštová banka and its digital arm 365.bank publish launch and award news here; 365.bank is the most digital-native Slovak bank (Euromoney best digital bank) and its releases describe app, onboarding and payment feature go-lives. Now inside the KBC/ČSOB perimeter.

source_name: J&T BANKA Slovensko – Tlačové správy / Spravodajstvo
why_relevant: Private/investment bank with its own SK press-release archive; smaller but an early adopter of instant payments in Slovakia, so its announcements date niche vendor go-lives.

source_name: Fio banka – Tlačové správy (SK)
why_relevant: Low-cost challenger bank present in SK; publishes pricing, channel and service changes. Useful for completeness of the SK bank set and for spotting instant-payment/e-channel changes at a small operator.

source_name: Prima banka Slovensko – corporate site (news / important information)
why_relevant: Branch-dense retail bank ('Jediná v každom okrese') – a natural buyer of branch redesign, ATM/self-service and e-channel technology. Its site carries product news and operational notices; I did not confirm a dedicated /tlacove-spravy path in this pass.

source_name: UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia – SK site
why_relevant: Cross-border branch operating in SK; group-level digital and payments programmes land here. Document repository is rich but a dedicated SK press archive was not confirmed in this pass.

source_name: Allianz – Slovenská poisťovňa – Tlačové centrum
why_relevant: Largest SK insurer; its press centre documents digital go-lives in detail – online claims service centre, the 'Môj Allianz' customer portal, digital claim handling with document upload. Insurer-side analogue of bank digital-channel projects and a buyer of the same onboarding/document tech.

source_name: Union poisťovňa – corporate/news site
why_relevant: Insurer whose mobile app added self-service vehicle inspection by client photo – a concrete instance of image/AI-assisted onboarding tech in SK insurance. Announcements of this type name or imply the technology supplier.

source_name: Slovenská pošta – Pre médiá / Tlačové správy
why_relevant: State-owned postal operator, historically tied to Poštová banka and a large counter/self-service network. Its releases announce app and counter-service digitalisation (submission, tracking, discounts in-app) – on-cell for state-institution go-lives and branch/counter technology.

source_name: MIRRI SR – Ministry of Investments, Regional Development and Informatization
why_relevant: Owns Slovakia's digital-transformation agenda (Akčný plán digitálnej transformácie 2023–2026, DESI strategy) and announces e-government go-lives, digital identity and electronic-ID projects that banks reuse for onboarding. Strategy PDFs also name intended platforms and timelines, useful for anticipating tenders.

source_name: tlacovespravy.sme.sk – SME press-release wire
why_relevant: Verbatim press-release syndication portal used by Slovak banks (Tatra banka digital mortgage, 365.bank positioning, Slovenská sporiteľňa awards). Aggregates releases that sometimes disappear from bank sites, giving a single crawlable archive and a de-facto timestamped record.

source_name: omediach.com – Tlačové správy archive
why_relevant: Deep, paginated archive of Slovak corporate press releases including bank items (e.g. the 365.bank best-digital-bank release). Its long pagination makes it useful for back-filling historical announcements that banks have pruned.

source_name: SITA – voFinanciach.sk, banks category
why_relevant: National news agency's finance desk; carries bank announcements and multi-bank stories (e.g. the payme QR/payment-link service adopted by ČSOB, VÚB, Prima banka, 365.bank, SLSP and Tatra banka covering >85% of the market) plus per-institution tag pages that act as a per-actor archive.

source_name: FinReport.sk – banks & insurers / fintech desk
why_relevant: Specialist SK financial-services trade outlet covering both banking and insurance. Reports vendor/product launches (BLIK entering Slovakia, mobile-app feature waves, Slovenská pošta app digitalisation) and republishes agency items – a high-recall net for cell events, and it maintains an encyclopaedia of sector actors useful for the actor map.

source_name: Banky.sk – Slovak bank directory and app-news tracker
why_relevant: Maintains a dedicated running page of 'what's new in Slovak banking mobile apps' plus a per-bank directory (legal entity, ID, profile). Cheapest way to date mobile-app feature go-lives across all SK banks in one place and to complete the actor map with exact legal names.

source_name: poistovne.sk – Slovak insurer directory and news
why_relevant: Insurance counterpart of banky.sk: per-insurer profile pages (Allianz-SP, Union, etc.) plus articles on digital claims handling. Use it to enumerate SK insurers and locate each one's press page, which is otherwise hard to find.

source_name: BLIK (Polski Standard Płatności) – newsroom, Slovak market section
source_subtype: vendor newsroom (counterparty to a SK bank)
why_relevant: Vendor-side mirror of a Slovak bank partnership: BLIK's newsroom announced its Slovak launch and the continuation of its cooperation with Tatra banka through the Tatra banka VIAMO app. Vendor newsrooms often name the bank and the date before the bank's own release does, so pairing both sides confirms and dates deals.

source_name: Soitron – prípadové štúdie (customer case studies)
why_relevant: SK systems integrator publishing named bank case studies (e.g. Tatra banka's remote personal-banking service connecting clients with bankers). Integrator case studies are the richest public description of what was actually delivered inside a Slovak bank, and they are published because both sides benefit.

source_name: The Slovak Spectator – business/banking desk (EN)
why_relevant: English-language SK outlet reporting bank infrastructure milestones (instant payments availability across all Slovak banks). Useful as an English-language cross-check and for briefing non-Slovak-speaking analysts on events first reported in SK.

source_name: Google Play / Apple App Store – SK bank app listings and release notes
why_relevant: App-store release notes and version history give an independent, precisely dated record of when a feature actually shipped (biometric login, wallet, instant payments, QR pay) – frequently earlier and more granular than the bank's press release, and they expose the developer/publisher entity.

source_name: Diebold Nixdorf – DN Series Success Stories / Customer Case Studies
why_relevant: Vendor-published customer stories hub for banking self-service; the place where any Slovak or CEE bank ATM/branch-automation win would be published as attributable proof of an incumbent relationship.

source_name: Diebold Nixdorf s.r.o. (Slovak legal entity) – company/directory listing
why_relevant: Confirms Diebold Nixdorf has a Slovak operating entity (Bratislava, banknote sorters / ATM line) — the local delivery arm behind any SK bank contract; useful anchor for entity-level snowballing into registers and tenders.

source_name: Auriga SpA – Customer Stories (EN) and Storie di successo (IT)
why_relevant: Auriga (WWS ATM/omnichannel software) publishes named bank references; a Slovak or CEE entry would evidence a direct competitor foothold against Printec/NCR-based estates. No SK entry surfaced in search — worth monitoring rather than assumed absent.
